top_comments.text: I use AI primarily to easily find out something. If I see a scene from a movie, show, game, etc.? and I want to know what happens without having to buy it, get through the content and find out for myself, I can find out by typing a couple prompts into the AI. Likewise for anything else I just use it when its more efficient
